column3: You're surrounded by people. Friends, family, a group chat that never stops. So why do you still feel alone?
If you've ever felt that, you're in good company. One of the most popular anime heroes ever was built on that exact feeling.
Naruto Uzumaki grew up in a village full of people. And almost none of them would look at him.
Today: what Naruto's story, and real research, can teach us about loneliness. And what actually helps.
